def row2image(row):
    pixels, emotion = row['pixels'], emotion_map[row['emotion']]
    img = np.array(pixels.split(), dtype=np.uint8)
    img = img.reshape((48, 48))
    image = np.zeros((48, 48, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    image[:, :, 0] = img
    image[:, :, 1] = img
    image[:, :, 2] = img

    return image, emotion

# Get the unique emotions in the data and sort them
unique_emotions = sorted(data['emotion'].unique())

plt.figure(0, figsize=(16,10))
for i, emotion_val in enumerate(unique_emotions, 1):
    face = data[data['emotion'] == emotion_val].iloc[0]
    img, label = row2image(face)
    plt.subplot(2,4,i)
    plt.imshow(img)
    plt.title(label)

plt.show()
